_comment: Reasoned exemptions from the identity-translation check in tools/check_catalog_parity.py: msgids whose translation is legitimately byte-identical to the English source. Two classes need no entry here because the checker recognises them mechanically -- a msgid with no alphabetic content once its {placeholders} are removed (a bare number, a lone placeholder), and a single all-caps code token or bare URL (OK, CSV, PDF, GTFS, https://...). Everything else that is genuinely the same in the target language -- a product name, a proper noun, a borrowed word -- takes an entry with a written reason, because the judgement is not one a pattern can make. The checker deletes nothing for you: an entry whose msgid the template no longer declares, or whose msgstr has since been translated, fails the gate until it is removed. That is the point. The list is empty because the current seven rider-facing strings are all full sentences and all three catalogs translate every one of them.
